chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Al-Husayn ibn Saeed, from Al-Nadr ibn Suwayd, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Allah, Mighty and Majestic, appoints two angels at the two narrow points of Arafat, so they say: 'Safety! Safety!'

key_terms.مَأْزَمَيْ عَرَفَةَ: The two narrow points or passes of Arafat

ai.seo_question: What do the angels say at the narrow points of Arafat during Hajj?
ai.summary: In al-Kafi, this hadith highlights the spiritual significance of the departure from Arafat, where two angels stationed at its narrow passes (ma'azim) call out 'Salām' (Safety/Peace), marking the culmination of the pilgrim's standing. This divine announcement underscores the transition from the intense spiritual state of Arafat to the subsequent rites, reflecting the Shia emphasis on the angelic witness and divine mercy during the Hajj rituals.
